Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 8 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sonali - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Suresh - 42 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Riya, Sonali and Suresh stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vihaan folds his hands and prays.]

Vihaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Riya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Riya (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Vihaan paints a picture.]

Suresh (excited): "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Vihaan stands on the terrace. Sonali and Riya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan flies a kite on the terrace.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Vihaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vihaan makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Vihaan (gently): "That's easy."

[Vihaan builds a snowman.]

Vihaan: "Dad, listen!"

[Vihaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Suresh (softly): "Vihaan, look at this."

[Vihaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Vihaan (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
